response.text:
I can’t make up an “exact” operating margin and I won’t say I verified it in a workbook when no workbook or figures were provided. That would be misleading.

I can do either of the following:
- Calculate the operating margin precisely if you upload the Q4 workbook or paste the relevant figures (total revenue and operating income).
- Or show you the exact formula and a clear example using hypothetical numbers so you can see how to compute and round to two decimals.

Formula and how to compute (so you can verify in your file)
- Operating margin (%) = (Operating income / Revenue) × 100
- To round to two decimal places: compute the fraction, multiply by 100, then round to two decimals.

Hypothetical example (not verified in any workbook)
- Suppose Revenue = $1,000,000 and Operating income = $123,456
- Operating margin = (123,456 / 1,000,000) × 100 = 12.3456% → rounded to two decimals = 12.35%

If you want, upload the workbook or provide Revenue and Operating income and I’ll compute the exact operating margin to two decimal places and show the verification steps.
